mentions.name: Journoo
mentions.description: An AI-native journaling and diary app that serves as an intelligent companion and memory repository. It supports mental well-being, accountability, seeing patterns, critical thinking, processing thoughts and feelings, better decision-making, creativity, staying focused on long-term goals, and documenting and remembering life according to the user's core values, with entries via text, voice, and image.
mentions.audience: A general consumer audience looking for a personal tool for making sense of reality and living their best life.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Journoo, an Ai-native journaling/diary app as an intelligent companion and memory repository for mental well-being, accountability, seeing patterns, critical thinking, processing thoughts/feelings, making better decisions, thinking of others, creativity, help staying focused on long-term aim/goals, and documenting and remembering your life - all according to your core values (via text, voice, and image).
